name: nokta-academy-monorepo
description: Start backend (API :8081) and web (UI :5173 with /api proxy) together.

scripts.dev: concurrently -n backend,web -c blue,green "npm run dev --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix frontend"
scripts.validate:backend: npm run lint --prefix backend && npm run build --prefix backend && npm run test --prefix backend && npm run validate-integrations --prefix backend && npm run validate-api --prefix backend
scripts.validate:frontend: npm run sync-locale-extras --prefix frontend && npm run typecheck --prefix frontend && npm run test --prefix frontend && npm run build --prefix frontend && npm run validate-permissions --prefix frontend && npm run validate-translations --prefix frontend && npm run test:offline --prefix frontend && npm run test:e2e --prefix frontend
